package domain

import "testing"

func TestNormalizeContentSourceKey(t *testing.T) {
	tests := []struct {
		name    string
		input   string
		want    string
		wantErr bool
	}{
		{name: "empty legacy key", input: "   ", want: ""},
		{name: "valid key", input: "knowledge-tree.foundation.lesson-1/task:check", want: "knowledge-tree.foundation.lesson-1/task:check"},
		{name: "uppercase", input: "Knowledge-Tree.lesson", wantErr: true},
		{name: "path traversal", input: "knowledge-tree/../lesson", wantErr: true},
		{name: "leading punctuation", input: ".knowledge-tree.lesson", wantErr: true},
	}

	for _, test := range tests {
		t.Run(test.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			got, err := NormalizeContentSourceKey(test.input)
			if test.wantErr {
				if err == nil {
					t.Fatal("expected validation error")
				}
				return
			}
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatalf("NormalizeContentSourceKey returned error: %v", err)
			}
			if got != test.want {
				t.Fatalf("NormalizeContentSourceKey = %q, want %q", got, test.want)
			}
		})
	}
}
